title: hushrun.token/v1
description: Output of `hushrun token create|list|revoke --format json` (spec C-17): an org's agent tokens, as its backend answers them (results-v0 §3). `create` adds the token itself, shown once, to the created token's fields; `list` gives `items`; `revoke` gives `revoked`.

token.description: create: the agent token, hra_ and 40 base62 characters.

backend.description: create: the org's URL, where the token records.

hushrun_agent.description: create (ADR 0046): the one string a sandbox needs, for HUSHRUN_AGENT: the backend, the token and the key, shown once. This is how a script gets it: stdout is the token alone without --format json.

machine_key.description: create (ADR 0028, amended 2026-10-28): the agent's machine key, made with the token, registered with it and shown once: its PEM for HUSHRUN_MACHINE_KEY, where CI outside GitHub uses it, its public key, and its key id.

machine.description: create: the machine the backend registered with the token (results-v0 §3): the key in machine_key, named agent:<name>.

items.description: list: the org's agent tokens that aren't revoked, newest first.

name.description: The agent: its results record as agent:<name>.

repository.description: host/owner/name, or null for the whole org.

prefix.description: hra_ and 6 characters, to tell tokens apart.
